brief: Check whether a waiting period leaves a stated near-term event uncovered.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Coverage Timing"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Revisa cuándo inicia cobertura"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Veja quando começa cobertura"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Check whether a waiting period leaves a stated near-term event uncovered.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Purchase and coverage dates may differ; read the waiting rule before relying on protection.
instruction.misconception: Paying today means every event today qualifies, or a later claim date fixes an event that occurred during a waiting period.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Compare the event date with the stated coverage start. A later claim date does not change when the event occurred.
The event occurs before the stated coverage start.
The stated start includes the event day.
The event date remains before the stated eligibility date.
The illness event follows its own stated waiting rule.
The missing timing terms prevent confirming near-term protection.
The timing condition fails despite the other conditions being met.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
